tests.name: i18n getSiteConfig returns brConfig when locale is pt-BR
i18n getSiteConfig returns itConfig when locale is it-IT
i18n getSiteConfig returns enConfig when locale is en
i18n getSiteConfig throws Error with "Locale inválido" for unsupported locale
i18n getSiteConfig returns itConfig even when NEXT_PUBLIC_LOCALE=pt-BR (arg has precedence)
i18n getActiveLocale throws in production when NEXT_PUBLIC_LOCALE is not set
i18n getActiveLocale returns pt-BR in development when NEXT_PUBLIC_LOCALE is not set
i18n isLocale returns true for valid locale pt-BR
i18n isLocale returns false for unsupported locale fr-FR
i18n isLocale returns false for non-string value
